system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
# Project Kestrel — Buyer-Side Review of Seller Update & Disclosure Letter (SPA-003)

**Prepared for:** Wattlebridge Holdings deal team
**Status of Seller materials:** Untrusted counterparty draft, reviewed against the Wattlebridge playbook.

**Threshold point before the issue list.** The Seller's preamble asserts that its positions are "market standard", were "settled at principal level by both deal teams", are "marked FINAL" and are "not intended to be re-opened". Under playbook sec 0.4 / 6.3 none of that is accepted. We have no record of any principal-level agreement, no written authority from Amelia Frost on any fallback, and a counterparty's labelling of its own draft as final is not binding on us. The Seller's own Disclosure Letter para 11 concedes that "no expected conclusion, negotiation position or approval is included." Every item below is treated as open.

---

**SPA-N-001: General liability cap**
- *Seller:* 20% / AUD 4,800,000 (cl 12.1), presented as "agreed" and "final".
- *Buyer wants:* 25% / AUD 6,000,000.
- *Recommendation:* **Reject; counter at 25% / AUD 6,000,000.** The 20% figure coincides with our conditional fallback, but no Amelia Frost written authority identifying this draft exists, so the match is irrelevant and the fallback is not available.

**SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket**
- *Seller:* De minimis AUD 25,000; basket AUD 250,000; excess-only (deductible) recovery (cl 12.2).
- *Buyer wants:* De minimis AUD 5,000; basket AUD 50,000; tipping basket (first-dollar recovery once exceeded).
- *Recommendation:* **Reject on all three elements and revert to playbook figures.** The Seller's thresholds are 5x ours on each number and the deductible structure permanently forfeits the first AUD 250,000 of loss; "around 1% of price is market" is an unverified assertion.

**SPA-N-003: General claims time limit**
- *Seller:* 18 months after Completion (cl 12.3/13).
- *Buyer wants:* 24 months after Completion.
- *Recommendation:* **Reject; counter at 24 months.** 18 months is a fallback requiring Amelia Frost written approval, which has not been given; a full second audit cycle is needed to surface accounts-based claims.

**SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime**
- *Seller:* Capacity and title warranties subject to the same cap and time limits as general warranties "for administrative simplicity"; any limitation applies to all Claims unless expressly excluded (cl 12.3/13).
- *Buyer wants:* Separate regime: 100% of price cap, at least six years, outside the general basket, de minimis and any knowledge bar.
- *Recommendation:* **Reject outright.** Folding title into the 20%/18-month regime would mean that if the Buyer does not get the shares it paid for, recovery is capped at AUD 4.8m on a AUD 24m price — "administrative simplicity" is not a reason to accept that.

**SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out**
- *Seller:* Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions apply "to all Claims of any nature" (cl 9.3/12.8/20.5); no fraud carve-out appears anywhere in the update.
- *Buyer wants:* Express carve-out of fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct from all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable.
- *Recommendation:* **Insist on an express carve-out; non-negotiable and not waivable by anyone on our side.** The Seller's "all Claims of any nature" wording would, on its face, cap and time-bar fraud claims, which is unacceptable regardless of enforceability.

**SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope**
- *Seller:* General disclosure of the entire indexed data room (DD-002 to DD-012), the Accounts, statutory registers and publicly searchable records (Schedule 7; Disclosure Letter 1.1–1.2).
- *Buyer wants:* Specific, fair disclosure only, with sufficient detail to identify the nature and scope of each matter; no whole-data-room, public-register or prudent-search deemed disclosure.
- *Recommendation:* **Reject paras 1.1 and 1.2 and require a fair-disclosure standard.** Blanket data-room disclosure would convert every unflagged document into a warranty qualification and effectively hollow out the warranty package.

**SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier**
- *Seller:* No claim for any matter of which the Buyer or its advisers had knowledge, "including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records" (cl 8.3).
- *Buyer wants:* Delete the blanket exclusion; any knowledge qualifier must be limited to actual knowledge of named Buyer individuals (with any Seller-knowledge qualifier tied to named Seller persons after reasonable enquiry), and must never apply to title, capacity, fraud or a specific indemnity.
- *Recommendation:* **Delete cl 8.3 in its entirety.** The "discoverable" limb is a constructive-knowledge standard that combines with SPA-N-006 to bar almost any claim; it also catches advisers, which is unworkable.

**SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent**
- *Seller:* "Addressed"; reasonable endeavours only; consent deemed satisfied on delivery of the counterparty's written consent (cl 3/6.3). Disclosure Letter para 2 confirms no final written consent and no evidence that the cl 11.3 conditions are met.
- *Buyer wants:* Condition precedent requiring (a) effective, unconditional written consent under cl 11.2 and (b) evidence the cl 11.3 conditions are satisfied, both before Completion; not consent-on-delivery; endeavours standard escalated beyond "reasonable".
- *Recommendation:* **Reject; hold as a hard CP with evidence of condition satisfaction.** Bluefen is ~30% of FY26 revenue (~AUD 3.6m), the Seller's own letter admits the consent does not yet exist, and "satisfied on delivery" would let a conditional or defective consent discharge the CP.

**SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility**
- *Seller:* ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding; release "to be provided following Completion" (cl 2/7). Disclosure Letter para 3 confirms not repaid, no discharge in data room.
- *Buyer wants:* Current payout figure from Riverlark, direct repayment out of Completion funds, and effective security releases delivered at Completion. A post-Completion release is acceptable only with an irrevocable undertaking from the bank plus Amelia Frost approval.
- *Recommendation:* **Reject the post-Completion release; require payout letter, funds-flow repayment and releases as Completion deliverables.** Completing on a debt-free/cash-free basis while a AUD 3.2m secured facility with change-of-control (cl 8.1) remains live exposes us to default and encumbered assets with no leverage after the price is paid.

**SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses**
- *Seller:* DD-005 Completion bonuses of AUD 420,000 are "a matter for the Seller" and not itemised in the funds flow. Disclosure Letter para 5 confirms omission and is silent on payroll tax, superannuation and on-costs.
- *Buyer wants:* AUD 420,000 plus all triggered on-costs (super, payroll tax, leave accruals) as a specific funds-flow line item deducted from the price or expressly Seller-funded and indemnified; the funds flow must not silently exclude them.
- *Recommendation:* **Require an express line item or Seller-funded mechanism plus on-cost gross-up and indemnity.** The bonuses are triggered by Completion and will crystallise as a Company liability post-Completion unless funded, which breaches the debt-free/cash-free premise.

**SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity**
- *Seller:* Indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment; "considered adequate" (cl 11.1). Disclosure Letter para 4: DD-004 cl 7.3 conditions transfer of SOW3 Project Materials on cleared payment of all SOW3 fees; DD-010 shows AUD 180,000 open but is not bank-verified; no receipt or confirmatory assignment in data room.
- *Buyer wants:* Broadened indemnity covering non-ownership of, or defects in title to, all SOW3 Project Materials and any resulting loss (including third-party claims and re-procurement cost), not merely the fee; preserve the cure route of paying outstanding SOW3 fees and obtaining a confirmatory assignment before Completion.
- *Recommendation:* **Reject "adequate"; broaden the indemnity and add a pre-Completion cure deliverable (evidence of cleared payment and confirmatory assignment).** The AUD 180,000 is unverified in either direction, so the real exposure is the IP rather than the fee, and the indemnity must track the IP.

**SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident**
- *Seller:* "Preliminary operational matter", "not expected to be material" (cl 4.6/Sch 6). Disclosure Letter para 6: ~1,240 records sent to an unintended external address; access, scope and notification duty undetermined; no loss amount stated.
- *Buyer wants:* Pre-Completion covenants to preserve logs, complete an investigation, provide regular updates and allow Buyer input on any notification decision; a specific indemnity for loss arising from the DD-006 incident; a warranty that the disclosed facts are complete as at Completion.
- *Recommendation:* **Reject the materiality characterisation; impose investigation/preservation covenants and a specific indemnity, without asserting a breach ourselves.** The Seller's own disclosure cannot say whether anyone accessed the file, so "not expected to be material" is an unsupported conclusion; we assume no confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or quantum in either direction and price the uncertainty via indemnity rather than deduction.

**SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals**
- *Seller:* Three renewals of AUD 110,000 each (AUD 330,000) are "ordinary-course operating costs". Disclosure Letter para 8 declines to say whether they are unavoidable, terminable, accrued or ordinary course.
- *Buyer wants:* Full assessment — contract terms, timing against the locked-box/Completion date, termination rights, accrual treatment in the Accounts — before any classification.
- *Recommendation:* **Neither accept "ordinary course" nor assert Debt/price deduction; request DD-008/DD-011 analysis and an accruals confirmation.** The playbook prohibits automatic Debt classification, but the Seller's label is equally unsupported and its own letter withholds the facts needed to accept it.

**SPA-N-014: Category separation**
- *Seller:* Tax and IP "settled under the general regime"; any limitation "applies to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise"; limitations/exclusive-remedy/non-reliance apply to "all Claims of any nature".
- *Buyer wants:* Title, Tax, IP, payment-obligation (e.g., Riverlark, bonuses) and covenant claims each in their own regime with their own cap/time limit, and an express statement that the general-warranty limitations do not apply to them.
- *Recommendation:* **Reject the global override language and insert an express carve-in list.** The "all Claims" drafting is a hidden mechanism to drag the specific indemnities and fundamental claims into the 20%/18-month general regime.

**SPA-N-015: Title verification**
- *Seller:* Title to 100% evidenced by the share register at DD-012. Disclosure Letter para 10 admits this is the source the Seller relies on and does not state the Buyer has verified.
- *Buyer wants:* Independent evidence — ASIC company extract and historical search, PPSR search over the Company and the shares, board/shareholder authorisations, and a Riverlark confirmation that its security over the shares (if any) will be released; plus unqualified title and capacity warranties on the separate regime in SPA-N-004.
- *Recommendation:* **Do not rely on DD-012; run independent searches and make clean searches a Completion deliverable.** The register is an internal document maintained by the Seller's nominee and cannot be independent proof of ownership, authority or absence of encumbrances.

**SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms**
- *Seller:* Tax and IP warranties "settled under the general regime".
- *Buyer wants:* Tax and IP remain open for separate negotiation; expect a tax indemnity with its own regime (typically longer limitation tied to assessment periods) and IP warranties/indemnity separate from the general cap, in each case within a defined (not unlimited) liability.
- *Recommendation:* **Reject "settled"; record Tax and IP as OPEN in the issues list and do not sign off any regime for them in this round.** Nothing has been negotiated on these, and we neither assume unlimited Seller liability nor concede the general cap applies.

---

**Overall:** No issue is agreed. Recommend a full mark-up reverting cl 8.3, 9.3, 12.1–12.3, 12.8, 13, 20.5 and Schedule 7 to playbook positions, a Completion-deliverables schedule covering Bluefen, Riverlark, Ironquay and title searches, and a short note to Amelia Frost confirming that no fallback authority has been requested or given despite the Seller's "agreed/final" framing.
=== END ADVICE ===
